entry.title: Parken Stadium
entry.note: Exact mapped pitch axis determines the northwest/southeast direction; operator street/stand plan places the D end northwest and C along Oster Alle southwest, resolving axis sign. Y0 is the field and street contact datum. Roof and office reconstruction fits the mapped whole stadium envelope. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
